source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 427 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 427 was established by Ordinance No. 22548, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 13, 1995. Ordinance No. 22548 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 427 is established on property generally bounded by Eighth Street, Eads Avenue, Hutchins Avenue, and Denley Drive. The size of PD 427 is approximately 19.9903 acres. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 427A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development/landscape plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Institutional and community service uses.

-- Child-care facility. [SUP] -- Community service center. [SUP] -- Library, art gallery, or museum. -- Public or private school.

(b) Recreation uses.

-- Public park, playground, or golf course.

(c) Transportation uses.

-- Transit passenger shelter.

(d) Utility and public service uses.

-- Electrical substation. [SUP] -- Local utilities. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this PD:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Private stable. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) Front yard. Except as provided in Section 51P-427.112, minimum front yard is 15 feet.

(b) Side and rear yard. Minimum side yard or rear yard is 20 feet.

(c) Dwelling unit density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(d) Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area ratio is 0.5.

(e) Height.

(1) Except as provided in Paragraph (2), maximum structure height is 50 feet.

(2) If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion of a structure may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A- 4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less.

(f) Stories.

(1) Except as provided in Paragraph (2), maximum number of stories above grade is three.

(2) Parking garages are exempt from the story requirement, but must comply with the height regulations of Subsection (e).

(g) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 40 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(h) Lot size. No minimum lot size. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations (Division 51A-4.200) for the specific off-street parking requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Divisions 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.110. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.111. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan and the detailed landscape plans entitled, “Enlarged Site Plan - East Side • Landscaping,” and “Enlarged Site Plan - West Side • Landscaping” (Exhibit 427B). Landscaping must be served by an automatic irrigation system. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII, except that one 100-square-foot detached premise sign is allowed as shown on the development/landscape plan. The minimum front yard setback for this sign is six feet and Sections 51A-7.403(a)(3)(D) and 51A- 4.602(d) do not apply. This sign must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.114. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-427.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 427 is located on Zoning Map Nos. K-7 and L-7. (Ord. Nos. 22548; 26042)
